ARIZONA election worker comes forward with allegations of ELECTION FRAUD exposing that 153,404 ballots were sent to adjudication with 54.7% flagged as overvotes, which is an extremely high number.

An inside Maricopa County ballot adjudicator claims she witnessed GOP votes for Andy Biggs systematically tossed as "overvotes," which gave the 2026 Arizona governor's race to Katie Hobbs.

The number of ballots flagged and adjudicated from Nov. 1-6 is extremely alarming.

- 153,404 ballots sent to adjudication.
- 54.70% flagged as overvotes.
- 27.82% ambiguous, 17.27% write-in.

Journalist Rachel Alexander, a former Maricopa elections attorney, was contacted by the election worker about the ongoing anomalies.

The Arizona ballot adjudicator claims she witnessed
Republican ballots marked for Biggs & Hobbs, with an X through the Biggs oval, which were then treated as overvotes.

Adjudicators then strip the Biggs vote, reading the X as  not what the voter intended to mark as their selection, which then awarded it to Hobbs.

Dual marks for Biggs plus Lombardo create overvotes where neither vote counts, cancelling them both out. This same pattern was appearing on Prop 144 and other races.

The election worker also noted that the ballots weren't stored in a secure location and were just in a hallway out in the open.

Maricopa County officials have not yet commented as these are new allegations being looked into, and 100% should be looked into, immediately.

The amount of flagged overvotes and adjudicated ballots in this race should tell you everything you need to know.
